meta.notes: Rule parameters for the 8 systems (docs/MVP_SCOPE.md §5) plus the importance rule (§9). Every number here is v0.1 tunable pack data — balance changes never touch code (INV-3). Values pinned by MVP_SCOPE or EVENT_SCHEMA examples are marked with a source note.

time.notes: MVP_SCOPE §8: full day ≈ 1440 ticks; 1 hour ≈ 60 ticks; typical action 2–8 ticks (see actions.json)

position_visibility.notes: node-based model: locations are graph nodes (entities.json exits); visibility input → knowledge output, never duplicate fields (MVP_SCOPE §9)

relations.notes: ev_0007 pins suspicion 0→25 together with status unknown→suspect; 50/75 are v0.1 defaults for hooks the spec names but does not number

knowledge.notes: EVENT_SCHEMA §3: rumor = transfer event with one-step fidelity decay; distortion from source incompleteness (D-007). Trusted tellers spread faster (§6 matrix)

states.notes: modifiers feed perception (position_visibility) and behavior; no group reputation in v0 (D-006)

fire.notes: fire has no counter-event: a burned tavern stays burned (T4, EVENT_SCHEMA §4). All rates are v0.1 defaults

crime_watch.notes: watch change = knowledge-transfer event between guards (D-006); 'document check in two hours' = 120 ticks seeded at event time (MVP_SCOPE §11)

director.buffer: hooks seeded at event time, never invented later
director.notes: D-005: the director releases already-seeded consequences; a complication from nowhere is a bug. Director-off A/B is mandatory (T8)

importance.notes: MVP_SCOPE §9: computed from entities touched + irreversibility + far hooks → low/medium/high; never by feel. Mapping thresholds are v0.1 defaults
